notes.title: Version 1.0 (Full Release)
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 (Full Release)

Campaign: Missions 6 to 15 are now available. Campaign is complete.
Feature: Player can leave the vehicle and walk in first-person perspective.
Feature: Fleet of unlocked vehicles can be found in the parking lot at the police headquarters.

After each unlock of a vehicle in the campaign or free play mode, this new car will also be available there. 
There is a coloured marker in front of each car which the player can use to enter by pressing the action button.

New game mode: After a campaign mission, the player now has the option of a "free game". He can drive through the world and complete police missions.

If a campaign mission was completed, the "Free Game" starts automatically.
The map now shows areas where the player can perform new police missions. The map symbols indicate the type of operation.
There are a total of 80 missions from four categories.
Mission - False Parker: In a defined and marked area the player has to find a false parker. The player searches for the vehicle in the marked area. Once the player has found the car, he has to stop and hand out a ticket, which successfully completes the mission.
Mission - Speedster: The player has to follow a marked speedster. For example, a vehicle moves at excessive speed on the motorway. The player hangs on to the speedster and has to track and stop it. If he succeeds, the mission is successfully completed.
Mission - Stolen car: The player has to find a stolen vehicle in a defined and marked area. The stolen vehicle is displayed as a picture with its license plate so that the player can find it. The player drives through the bordered, marked area and searches for the stolen vehicle. Once the player has found it and verified the license plate, he has to stop and make a report to complete the mission.
Mission - Accident: The player has to record an accident in a defined and marked area. For example, two vehicles are involved in an accident. The player drives to the marked area and searches for the accident. Once he has reached the scene of the accident, he must stop, get out and record the accident, which will successfully complete the mission.
There is a marker in front of the police headquarters that guides the player to the next campaign mission.

New Scenario: City
New feature: 10 ranks

After each successful completion of ten missions in the free game, the player advances one rank. The ranks are indicated by symbols in the HUD.
Rank 1: Officer I 
Rank 2: Officer II
Rank 3: Officer III
Rank 4: Sergeant I
Rank 5: Sergeant II
Rank 6: Lieutenant I 
Rank 7: Lieutenant II
Rank 8: Captain I 
Rank 9: Captain II
Rank 10: Captain III

Ten new player vehicles that can be unlocked by successfully complete missions in the free play mode.
Tutorial for the new features.

Best wishes,
your Toplitz Team
